title: Test whether a device-segment win survives its boundary
objective: Attempt to reproduce one device or SASS-level speedup at eager, graph, and containing-region scope before calling it useful.
steps: Retain the original segment measurement as mechanism evidence
Add dispatch, launch, synchronization, and output-consumption costs
Measure eager and independent graph replay
Measure the containing region on representative contexts

acceptance.pass: The containing region wins with no mode regression.
acceptance.no_win: The boundary erases or reverses the segment saving.

stop_rule: Source, SASS, or segment proof alone is never labeled a production win.
origin_evidence: Task06 measured 1.3713x/1.2834x for a device segment, while a fused graph variant measured only 0.877x/0.822x.
